architecture: Four learned bounded coefficients blend full-FK linear, frozen learned base and observed contextual motion, separately for root and articulated rotations.
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Select a new controller only when combined validation position+0.1rotation improves on V8 and old-validation position/rotation stay within 2% of V6; otherwise retain V8. No quality gates relaxed.
notes: No new downloads; original train/validation/confirmation ownership preserved.
Every controller training base prediction is produced without its entire catalog group.
No-context windows are included; learned residual may be suppressed independently of contextual motion.
Validation is used for selection. V8 confirmation is already observed and cannot support a fresh confirmation claim.
A failed model remains outside the add-on.
Rig semantic observation schema remains separate from this full source hierarchy experiment.
training_objective: Training-only least-squares convex blend targets from cross-fitted base predictions; cohort-weighted kernel regression maps observations to blend strengths.
experiment: Subject-catalog-group cross-fitting with a learned convex controller
crossfit_group: CMU catalog subject prefix before underscore; all clips/windows in a group stay in one fold. Catalog labels do not prove actor identity.
fold_assignment: Sorted subject prefixes round-robin across four folds; base training excludes the complete held-out group.
